text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"TL-002","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D12","page":1,"quote":"15"},{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D14","page":1,"quote":"1"}],"comment":"The threaded shank (feature F1) is dimensioned with nominal values only (D12 \"15\", D14 \"1\") and carries no fit or tolerance callout.
